prompt: Rename the Transaction field `memo` to `description` throughout this ledger project: the dataclass in ledger/models.py and every use of it in the ledger package and in the tests. Ledger JSON files must now store the text under the key "description", but load_ledger must still read older files that use "memo". CSV imports must keep accepting a "memo" column header (as well as "description"). Run the test suite (`python -m unittest discover -s tests`) at the end and make sure it passes.

metadata.summary: Rename a field used across seven files, with backward-compatible loading. Hidden check: new field name, old files still load, CSV headers, rules, CLI, no .memo left, suite passes.
